types.label: All-clear
types.rule: Near-identical, mostly-yes forms, and 30% or more of spot assessments report every child Saksham

types.label: Discerning
types.rule: Answers vary (variety 0.5 or more) and scores are within 5 points of, or below, DIET/SRG

types.label: Too little data
types.rule: Fewer than 60 visits or 10 shared-school comparisons
